title: The garage from the doorway, again
logline: The first private page's subject again, three weeks on, with no ruled grid under it this time: the garage from the doorway, the table, the lamp, the boxes to twenty. The page is what the first one was fighting.

panels.composition: The garage from its doorway: the drafting table under the lamp, the wall of numbered boxes ending at twenty, the dog's bed empty, the window, no grid under the drawing.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage studio seen from its doorway with a drafting table under a lamp, a wall of numbered cardboard boxes ending at twenty and an empty dog bed, no words legible
image.notes: Compare ro_2021-01-06: same view over a blue-pencil grid.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
